rows.Origin:
Bred by Interplant (Netherlands, 2007).
Introduced in Netherlands by Interplant BV in 2007 as 'Flash Night'.
rows.Bloom: Red blend. Red with white flecks. Small to medium, double (17-25 petals), cluster-flowered, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for cut flower. Remove spent blooms to encourage re-bloom. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes: 'INTertroning' mentioned as pollen parent of 'Harlequin Kordana'

colour: Red blend. Red with white flecks.
